description: This bar chart, titled “Proportion of incorrectly answered samples where RPop_Ge is less than RPop_GT,” compares the performance of three large language models—Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow)—across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis displays these three categories in left-to-right order, while the vertical axis, labeled “Ratio (%)”, uses a linear scale ranging from 50 to 90, with tick marks and labels spaced at intervals of 10. For each category, three bars are presented side-by-side, representing the respective model’s ratio. In the “Movies” category, the Llama3 bar reaches approximately 90%, the Qwen2 bar is also at approximately 90%, and the ChatGPT bar is at approximately 72%. In the “Songs” category, the Llama3 bar is approximately 84%, the Qwen2 bar is approximately 90%, and the ChatGPT bar is approximately 63%. In the “Basketball” category, the Llama3 bar is approximately 67%, the Qwen2 bar is approximately 58%, and the ChatGPT bar is approximately 61%. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the categories as labeled on the horizontal axis. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or annotations beyond their standard color coding and height.
